title: Hurry Up Whiskey — acoustic hook to camera
hook: Some nights the whiskey can't come fast enough.
body: Wrote this one for the nights you're trying to catch up to a feeling. Hurry Up Whiskey — out now, and there's an acoustic version if you like it stripped all the way down.

script.visual: Truck tailgate, golden hour, guitar in lap, straight to camera
script.line: Some nights the whiskey can't come fast enough…

script.visual: Hold the shot, sing the hook line of the chorus
script.line: Sing the catchiest line of the chorus — real voice, no backing track

script.visual: Small smile, look off then back
script.line: Full song's out now — wrote it about exactly what it sounds like.
